node-1.label: A 54-year-old man presented to the emergency department with abdominal pain and shortness of breath

node-2.label: Patient has a medical history of hypertension and subglottic squamous cell carcinoma, treated with cisplatin and radiation therapy 8 months prior

node-3.label: Physical examination showed signs of respiratory distress; the patient rapidly deteriorated, requiring intubation and hemodynamic support with norepinephrine, phenylephrine, and vasopressin

node-4.label: Hospital course lasted 2 months and was complicated by pulmonary embolism, atrial fibrillation, and gastrointestinal bleeding
